sources.note: 940 traces across the Himalaya and Tibet. Carries fault NAMES, the originating REFERENCE and NET SLIP RATES, all three of which the GEM harmonisation drops. Contains the Main Frontal Thrust; contains neither the Main Boundary Thrust nor the Main Central Thrust.

The layer production already uses. VERIFIED 2026-10-28: all 57 features inside the Nepal window carry catalog_name='HimaTibetMap', so within Nepal this source is a strict subset of himatibetmap with fewer attributes. Kept in the registry because it is global and may contribute outside the Himalayan compilation's footprint.

sources.note: Suture zones. Structural boundaries, not active seismogenic sources.

properties.absence_note: MBT and MCT are absent from every source merged here, confirmed by exhaustive string search. They run through the Lesser and Higher Himalaya where the monitored corridors sit, so the thrust-distance column remains ~89-117 km per corridor and the fault-damage term stays saturated for them. This is a recorded gap, not a solved one.
